text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp is finally underway! Facing the greatest chance to build strength for the Swan Stakes, what is Bamboo Memory up to—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Summer training camp"... Ah...
That has such a great ring to it, sir...
Just saying it brings tears to my eyes, sir...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!!
Put me through hell!!
A hell that'll make my very soul tremble!!!"
choice_data_list: I'm gonna be strict with you — but just the right amount!
I'll be strict with you — but just the right amount!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the intense summer training camp began!!
